nodes.name: Claim next queued task and load checkpoint

parameters.query:
WITH candidate AS (
 SELECT id FROM lms_certification.pilot
 WHERE phase NOT IN ('certified','needs_review')
 AND data->>'contract' IN ('echo','fizzbuzz','heights','leap','length','meow','parity','parrot','python_exact','repeat4','reverse','sign','sum','temperature','until_empty','until_nonmultiple','until_zero','xmas','xmas2','xmas3','yes_no','zen')
 AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < clock_timestamp())
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lms_certification.pilot WHERE lease_until > clock_timestamp())
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN owner IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, updated_at, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE lms_certification.pilot p SET owner=$1, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '15 minutes'
FROM candidate c WHERE p.id=c.id RETURNING p.phase,p.data

UPDATE lms_certification.pilot
SET phase = $2, data = $3::jsonb, updated_at = clock_timestamp(),
lease_until = CASE WHEN $2 IN ('certified','needs_review') THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp() + interval '15 minutes' END
WHERE owner = $1 AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()
RETURNING phase, data

UPDATE lms_certification.pilot SET lease_until = NULL
WHERE owner = $1 RETURNING phase

SELECT phase, count(*)::int AS tasks,
 max(updated_at) AS latest_update FROM lms_certification.pilot GROUP BY phase ORDER BY phase
